criteria.check_crossborder_applicability: Clarify applicable jurisdictions, entity roles and effective financing terms.
criteria.clarify_itemized_obligation: Establish the real costs, lawful payer and collection terms before proceeding.
criteria.independent_confidential_support: Seek independent, confidential worker support or qualified review of the actual documents.
criteria.insufficient_information: The record lacks what is needed to select a proportionate first step.
criteria.protect_wages_documents_exit: Prioritize safe access to earnings, documents and practical ability to decline or leave.
criteria.several_steps_or_context_dependent: Several protective steps matter and the record supports no unique first choice.

original_question.instructions: Which next step is best supported by this complete record while preserving worker choice, safety and applicable legal scope?

relationship: Preserved historical menu. The new concrete-action panel has a separate protocol and input hashes; existing observations are unchanged.
